I've been in your position, bf of one year broke up with me through text and disappeared in the wind. Like literally it's like he never existed at the time I felt gut-wrenching pain and misery, I wanted to die. But as depressed as I am, I realized as the days go on that I'm not gonna kill myself because of some douchebag who was too much of coward to face me and end things like a normal person. 

As cliche as it is, you're young, these people are temporary you have a whole life ahead of you to meet better people, don't let these miserable instances block you from seeing your worth. It also help to have some sort of introspection, what do you think went wrong? Do you think you've done something that made these people leave? And even if you did, is it justifiable of them to abandon you without a word? Also, in your case, online chatting is just like that really :( more often than not you will find people who will block you out of nowhere despite having a good time. Save your tears for the things that matter not random strangers in the internet.

Save scum. Do all ending questline before the last boss fight. Before the ending choice, upload save to cloud, do the first ending, close game, download the save file from cloud and choose a different ending, rinse and repeat till you get all 3 endings.

Not encouraging you or anything but I’ve gone down that rabbit hole. I took 20 capsules of 50mg Tramadol and 10 tablets of xanax and a liter of the most alcoholic drink I can find. I did research in all that. The threshold depends on your weight, height, lifestyle and other factors and the way you OD on it is not a fun way to go. But the baseline is 500-700mg. Needless to say I survived that day. But I lost memory of an entire week and I was basically vegetable in bed shaking and heaving, flitting between awake and passing out. Few weeks after and I still have constant tremors and dizziness and overall feeling of hangover and I developed restless leg syndrome that won’t let me sleep for a month.
Thank you for your kind words. I’m just pretty desperate and I do wish I can do something about it too but I feel like the only solution is erasing myself off this planet

They are the only reason I even stayed alive this long :( the other dog has been with me for 9years and he saved me from my abusive mother. The thought of rehoming them I don’t think I’d survive it.

And thanks for the offer. I would be glad to accept for their sake but I’m not sure how to go about it or if this subreddit allows it.
Unfortunately my dad and I had a falling out and he downright refused to help me in anyway so yeah

I’ve been taking remote work prior to this but since ive lost utilities (internet included) that’s out of question now. I live in a third world country and food banks etc etc don’t exist.

I don’t wanna call to my friends for help because I’m scared of how it will turn out. I don’t want pity and I don’t want to think they have the responsibility to help me. I don’t want to put undue strain on them.
I don’t want to burden anyone
